deliverables: Reviewed engine patch series, read-at input implementation, bounded I/O/cache bridge
validation: Remote/cold corpus across affected codecs with cache smaller than corpus and injected errors/timeouts.
definition_of_done: Remote reads do not require full-file heap residency; published cold path includes measured range counts.

tasks.title: Build resolved-operation preparation
tasks.goal: Evaluate conditional mutations once against committed state.
deliverables: Canonical operation identity/version map, script/patch resolver and idempotency outcome storage
validation: Dependent updates/create races; failed commit after preparation; replay with time/random input changes.
definition_of_done: Speculative state cannot influence a committed dependent mutation; replay never reruns nondeterministic scripts.

tasks.title: Implement apply and reader barriers
tasks.goal: Separate commit, apply and search visibility.
deliverables: Ordered replay/apply, committed reader manager, refresh batching and query/fetch pinning
validation: Refresh before/after failed persistence, duplicate/gap replay, crash between apply/refresh and concurrent fetch.
definition_of_done: Every reader reports an exact contiguous prefix and cannot expose uncommitted writes.

tasks.title: Integrate cache, materialization and merges
tasks.goal: Bound indexing/read resources and immutable file lifetime.
deliverables: Version/domain-keyed cache adapter, disk reservations, pinned mmap/materialization and merge scheduling
validation: Evict/open/merge races, disk full, cache corruption/failure fallback and engine shutdown.
definition_of_done: Cache eviction cannot invalidate live readers; source integrity errors are never hidden as cache misses.

tasks.title: Qualify engine bridge
tasks.goal: Prove read/write semantic and recovery fidelity.
deliverables: Java/Lucene differential report, release-profile engine tests, remote/local benchmark and adapter review
validation: Open/update/delete/merge/restart, analyzer/scoring/float parity and corruption corpus.
definition_of_done: Frozen supported contract and coverage pass; unsupported capabilities remain explicit; remote path isn't silently materialized.

milestones.title: mTLS, tenant policy and BYOK
milestones.goal: Deliver identity/authorization and portable envelope encryption before production data formats are activated.
definition_of_done: All peer roles require validated mTLS identity and scoped authorization, with rotation and negative handshake evidence.
Object/WAL/key formats use authenticated bounded blocks and vetted crypto; no plaintext production spill path is left unaccounted for.
Wrap/unwrap providers, rotation, revocation and hardware dispatch have executable conformance evidence; real cloud providers close in M15.

tasks.title: Implement identity and role authorization
tasks.goal: Keep client, peer, admin and replication authority separate.
deliverables: IdentityProvider, verified principal types, policy generations, dev CA and SPIFFE/file adapters
validation: Wrong CA/SAN/cluster/role, expired cert, public-token peer access and tenant spoof tests.
definition_of_done: Every peer RPC has explicit role/tenant checks and cert verification cannot be disabled by ordinary config.

tasks.title: Implement key-provider contract
tasks.goal: Make key wrapping replaceable without exposing key material.
deliverables: KeyProvider API, isolated test KMS, provider errors, bounded DEK cache and audit schema
validation: Wrap/unwrap context/version mismatch, throttle/denial/timeout, cancellation and zeroization checks.
definition_of_done: Plaintext keys never enter logs/evidence; test provider is refused in production profile.

tasks.title: Ratify encrypted block format
tasks.goal: Make portable authenticated random access safe.
deliverables: Reviewed envelope/header/AAD/nonce specification, AEAD codec and vectors
Bounded inline initial wrapped-DEK envelope and authenticated object/domain binding; optional external rewrap overlay selected by published metadata/policy
validation: Known-answer and independent decrypt; header/block substitution, every-byte damage, retry/crash nonce controls.
Verify inline and rewrapped keys, wrapper/context substitution, crash before overlay publication, revoked old policy and unchanged ciphertext AAD; never accept an unauthenticated provider wrapper
definition_of_done: One fresh DEK per immutable object; only authenticated plaintext reaches parsers; format has explicit size/invocation bounds.

tasks.title: Encrypt every persistent data path
tasks.goal: Cover object data, logs, cache and engine scratch.
deliverables: Encryption decorators, encrypted-volume/directory readiness policy, spill inventory
validation: Inspect on-disk object/journal/cache/spool bytes; verify engine scratch volume policy and fail unprotected production startup.
definition_of_done: Object encryption cannot be claimed as full at-rest protection while engine scratch remains plaintext.

tasks.title: Implement rotation and revocation state machines
tasks.goal: Retire key versions without breaking pinned readers or promising instant revocation.
deliverables: Immutable envelope rewrap publication, dependency inventory, policy invalidation and bounded key/reader TTL
validation: Concurrent rewrap/PIT/GC/restart, KMS outage, revoked cached key and policy partition histories.
definition_of_done: Old roots keep needed envelopes; expired policy fails closed; measured revocation envelope is documented.

tasks.title: Verify hardware crypto and runtime TLS rotation
tasks.goal: Use target hardware safely and preserve active operation boundaries.
deliverables: x86/ARM crypto dispatch reporting, fallback tests and cert/bundle rotation implementation
validation: Force software/accelerated paths and compare bytes; rotate certificates during streams; stalled unwrap budget test.
definition_of_done: No unsupported instruction, plaintext fallback or authentication downgrade; actual backend is observable.

tasks.title: Complete security format review
tasks.goal: Close crypto/identity flaws before the durable-store release.
deliverables: Threat-model review, provider conformance report and encrypted-path acceptance artifacts
validation: Independent review plus adversarial corpus and >=90% security-crate coverage.
definition_of_done: Blocking security findings are fixed; cloud provider claims remain explicitly pending M15.

milestones.title: Object-durable search store on RustFS
milestones.goal: Deliver the first complete durable write/search/recovery path using object storage as the sole durable tier.
definition_of_done: Successful mutations survive loss of every compute cache/scratch directory when RustFS and keys remain intact.
Ordered committed WAL slots and separately published segment/schema roots recover a valid committed prefix; GC cannot delete pinned or unpublished-but-required dependencies.
An external client can ingest, query, restart, restore and verify a declared dataset on a real RustFS topology.
Object commits count payload/root/page/key attempts and use dirty-only compatible batching; successful cost reduction preserves restore/freshness semantics.

tasks.title: Implement object-WAL commit protocol
tasks.goal: Acknowledge only authoritative object-durable operations.
deliverables: Dirty-only group committer, conditional-create ordered WAL slots, inline wrapped-DEK envelope, explicit committed receipts and unknown-outcome resolution
Structural authority/checkpoint publication separate from append; resolved operation/crypto/schema dependencies validated before the commit PUT
validation: Kill/response-loss at upload/CAS/ack boundaries and concurrent old/new owners with independent receipts.
Measure dirty-only batching and payload/root/page/envelope attempts under sparse and hot tenants; preserve one authoritative domain per stream.
Compare the selected one-data-PUT path with payload-plus-head-CAS using the exact same conditional-write/recovery/freshness oracle; include activation, checkpoints, rewrap and strong-read barriers
definition_of_done: Only the authorized next slot of an established fenced lane commits; an arbitrary uploaded object is never acknowledged
No later slot follows a failed/ambiguous append; one in-flight append per lane and permanent fence/tail invariants survive reopen/recovery

tasks.title: Publish segments and archive coordinates
tasks.goal: Make every published base recoverable.
deliverables: Pinned engine commit uploads, manifest/root publisher, schema/key dependencies
validation: Crash at every upload/reference/CAS boundary; verify all root dependencies before open.
definition_of_done: Base/archive coordinates represent contiguous committed history and never speculative engine state.

tasks.title: Implement bounded recovery and replay
tasks.goal: Recover without relying on local state.
deliverables: Streaming replay/spill, base selection, idempotency/version reconstruction and readiness barrier
validation: Delete compute caches/scratch; restart with duplicate/gap/corrupt/oversized histories.
definition_of_done: Recovered documents/versions match independent receipt ledger; missing committed history blocks readiness.

tasks.title: Implement compaction, pins and GC
tasks.goal: Reclaim objects without losing live or recoverable views.
deliverables: Compaction source validation, coordinated durable pins/boundary, dry-run and sweep workers
validation: Suspend publisher across GC; race pin creation/expiration and updates/deletes during merge; restart sweep.
definition_of_done: Every live root remains readable; stale publishers cannot resurrect swept generations.

tasks.title: Deliver lifecycle and standalone API
tasks.goal: Make local end-to-end use operationally complete.
deliverables: Index/schema/create/delete, bulk/get/search/refresh, health/readiness and durable job controls
Native /v1 capabilities/receipts and explicitly selected thin adapter routes; core request/response/queue/retention admission
Early selected OpenSearch-reference and intentional-difference/unsupported conformance corpus; no broad SDK promise
validation: External process client against RustFS with encrypted data and identity checks; delete/recreate name races.
Run profile G02 plus parser/admission/unknown-parameter, CRUD/bulk/item order, latest GET and postcommit visibility-timeout histories before standalone qualification
definition_of_done: Client-visible semantics match M02 matrix and lifecycle never reuses old authority/history.
All advertised standalone core-v1 operations and limits have runtime evidence; deferred/unsupported semantics remain visible and do not trigger fake responses.

tasks.title: Qualify RustFS durability and restore
tasks.goal: Close the first real-store milestone with evidence.
deliverables: Receipt-ledger audit, process/fault campaign, complete-compute-loss restore report
validation: Fixed and randomized crash seeds, storage errors, key unavailable and fresh-host restore.
definition_of_done: All acknowledged object-mode writes recover; runtime coverage and independent code/test review pass.

milestones.title: Distributed routing and query serving
milestones.goal: Scale query/index roles independently with mTLS and explicit freshness/completeness.
definition_of_done: Multiple nodes accept routed writes and fan out queries with correct document routing, reduce semantics and tenant isolation.
Latest/at-least/PIT reads validate receiver checkpoints; stale placement cannot downgrade freshness.
Node loss, hot tenant overload and shard movement preserve declared results or return explicit incomplete/unavailable status.
Zone-local serving and eligible fallback pass normal and zone-loss cost/capacity tests; direct object access is compared with paid cross-zone peers.
Core-v1 matching/different/unsupported semantics and total/concurrent work budgets pass early distributed conformance; later migration cannot retroactively define an unbounded API.

tasks.title: Implement membership and capacity placement
tasks.goal: Discover nodes and recommend placements without granting authority.
deliverables: Role/capacity/zone registry, rendezvous placement, drain and shard activation limits
Zone/cell endpoint identity and local-eligible placement policy with explicit profile fallback and capacity accounting.
validation: Join/leave/stale gossip, skew, duplicate identity and role-change histories.
definition_of_done: Routing hints cannot create writer authority or bypass receiver authorization/freshness.

tasks.title: Implement bounded authenticated peer RPC
tasks.goal: Connect roles using typed H2/mTLS messages.
deliverables: Peer transport, byte/count admission, stream deadlines and cancellation propagation
validation: Oversized prefix before allocation, slowloris, wrong role, stalled TLS/stream and certificate rotation.
definition_of_done: Queue/frame/connection/RSS budgets are reported; cert errors never fall back to weaker transport.

tasks.title: Implement mutation routing and failover
tasks.goal: Route to the current authoritative shard safely.
deliverables: Routing generation, forwarded identity context, old-owner rejection and retry identity handling
validation: Move ownership during in-flight index/create/CAS/delete; stale routes and lost replies.
definition_of_done: Independent histories show no duplicate committed identity or stale writer publication.

tasks.title: Implement distributed API admission and tenant budgets
tasks.goal: Preserve finite work and tenant isolation across routing/fanout before distributed query integration.
deliverables: Separate total-target/inflight-RPC budgets, byte/CPU/queue/retry accounting, deadline propagation and tenant share admission
Bounded scope resolution, cancellation cleanup and large-job handoff with truthful typed errors
validation: Profile G03: target/concurrency limit+one, hot-tenant skew, stalled peers, retry storms and coordinator cancellation
Measure actual queued/RPC/remote bytes and verify rejected or incomplete work cannot appear as an exact successful result
definition_of_done: Every distributed request and retry uses the admitted envelope; no full-catalog hot scan or unlimited fanout
Initial runtime fairness is qualified here; later M13 placement/fleet tests still prove large-scale behavior

tasks.title: Implement distributed query and reduction
tasks.goal: Preserve pinned shard semantics with bounded fanout.
deliverables: Selected core-v1 typed DSL/IR, bounded top-k/ties/sort, exact-or-refused finite aggregation profiles, pruning and explicit later optional global-statistics scoring
validation: Compare intended matching profile against pinned OpenSearch fixtures and intentional differences against native independent oracles; concurrent deletes, unsafe pruning, bucket and scope/fanout controls.
Compare eager versus leaf-reduced/delayed-fetch fanout and count encoded response bytes on each zone edge.
definition_of_done: Declared profile contract passes; memory/total work/concurrency bounded; exactness and partial results are truthful and explicit.

tasks.title: Implement replica freshness and PIT
tasks.goal: Serve required prefixes from eligible immutable readers.
deliverables: Published/latest/at_least modes, replica catch-up, PIT vectors/pins and token limits
Authoritative latest barriers and bounded WAL-tail discovery from structural checkpoints; cached manifests alone cannot certify latest
TTL/count/retained-byte snapshot quotas, stable query/sort cursors, routing/schema/profile binding and typed expiry; per-partition consistency is not global serializability
validation: Stale node and unavailable authority, refresh races, deadline expiry, topology change and PIT GC.
definition_of_done: No stale fallback for strong requests; query and fetch share the pinned generation.

tasks.title: Deliver zone-local serving and cost-aware read placement
tasks.goal: Avoid routine cross-zone fanout/cache bytes while keeping required reader eligibility and surviving capacity.
deliverables: Zone-local ingress/coordinator/worker cells, eligible fallback, object-versus-peer cache selection and bounded prewarm
Selective fresh subscriptions, delayed final document fetch and N-1 warm/capacity policy per profile
validation: Replay identical queries with local, cross-zone and direct-object paths; meter each edge and API attempt
Lose a cell, force a cold working set and test stale local replicas; compare fallback cost/latency and result completeness
definition_of_done: Cost ranking runs only after authorization/freshness checks; strong reads never silently downgrade
Normal/recovery fanout, duplicated caches and rejected traffic are accounted for; resilient profiles demonstrate surviving capacity

tasks.title: Qualify multi-node service
tasks.goal: Prove real distributed wiring and load isolation.
deliverables: 3+ node RustFS test topology, tenant fairness/failover report and reference corpus
validation: External clients across node kill/rejoin, overload, disk pressure and mTLS/key faults.
Run selected API conformance and G03-G05 bounded-scale/completeness controls now, before optional modules or late migration qualification
definition_of_done: Correctness and L1 baseline evidence pass; query/index resources scale separately.

milestones.title: Telemetry and AI-readable diagnostics
milestones.goal: Make the actual state of the system inspectable without secrets or uncontrolled diagnostic cost.
definition_of_done: Traces/logs/metrics correlate requests to shard/checkpoint/resource state with bounded cardinality and producer redaction.
Versioned diagnostic API/CLI and optional MCP expose scoped, paginated read-only summaries and artifact handles.
AI-only diagnostic exercises identify injected failures using operator-visible evidence; stalled telemetry does not stall search.
Cost diagnostics separate logical operations, provider attempts, directed bytes, rate provenance and budget/maintenance debt with bounded cardinality.

tasks.title: Define observability and error schemas
tasks.goal: Land instrumentation contracts before subsystems diverge.
deliverables: Stable tracing/error/checkpoint/resource fields, OTel facade and redaction policy
Early API admission/completeness/receipt, fanout, pin, retry and cost fields used by feasibility and first runtime gates
validation: Schema compatibility/cardinality tests; secret/document fixtures never emitted.
definition_of_done: Modules use one versioned event model and producer-side redaction.

evidence.result: Unpublished event/facade draft preserved in an isolated worktree; preliminary draft Rust/bootstrap passed, new production coverage blocked by native report protocol; no schema/runtime acceptance.
Coverage prerequisite accepted; original-model fixture is scoped report evidence, not finalM08/schema acceptance.

Actual finalsource R1clear, protected PR17 merge with identical reviewed tree; all7 PR/main native/sandbox jobs and full decoded288/compiler/source/catalog/reference/coverage/layout proof. Typed contract/facade only.

tasks.title: Instrument all critical stages
tasks.goal: Make latency, resource and durability gaps attributable.
deliverables: Mutation/query/storage/cache/crypto/replication spans and metrics, trace links and profiles
validation: Inspect end-to-end request timing, exporter stall, counter accuracy and sampling behavior.
definition_of_done: Commit/apply/searchable/archive are separately visible; telemetry buffers are bounded.

tasks.title: Implement diagnostic API and CLI
tasks.goal: Expose bounded scoped machine-readable state.
deliverables: Health/capabilities/shard/resource/retention/query/job diagnostics with pagination and snapshot generation
Profile/rate provenance, retry-attempt/traffic cost attribution and budget/maintenance-debt explain endpoints.
validation: Cross-tenant denial, output/time limits, truncation/cursor behavior and stale snapshot tests.
definition_of_done: Responses have provenance/build/schema IDs and cannot execute shell/code or expose keys.

tasks.title: Provide MCP facade and incident bundles
tasks.goal: Let AI retrieve only the evidence a diagnosis requires.
deliverables: Optional read-only MCP over existing API; redacted incident bundle manifest and replay handles
validation: Same authorization/conformance across CLI/API/MCP; prompt-injection log fixtures and expired handle tests.
definition_of_done: Facade adds no bypass and bundles carry hashes/redaction/limits without raw secrets.

tasks.title: Build AI incident evaluation corpus
tasks.goal: Evaluate diagnosis quality with real failures.
deliverables: Injected archive stall, stale reader, KMS revoke, expired cert, GC pin leak and corruption scenarios
validation: Give reviewer only public operator tools; measure root-cause accuracy, reads/tokens and unsafe suggestions.
definition_of_done: All critical scenarios identify actual cause and safe next action without cross-tenant disclosure.

tasks.title: Qualify telemetry overhead and resilience
tasks.goal: Keep diagnostics useful under production stress.
deliverables: Overhead/RSS/cardinality benchmark and monitoring runbooks
validation: Compare exporters enabled/disabled/stalled during overload; diagnostic flood and incident bundle cap.
definition_of_done: Service remains within budgets; observability degradation is visible and bounded.

milestones.title: Low-latency quorum journal module
milestones.goal: Deliver majority-fsync writes with independent fresh serving replicas and a bounded object archive backlog.
definition_of_done: Three-zone persistent quorum mode survives one voter/zone loss without acknowledged mutation loss and never serves speculative state.
Logical shards share bounded physical groups, with durable membership/snapshot/activation and no authority conflict with object mode.
Archive/recovery/retention have independent checkpoints and admission stops before unarchived history exhausts disk.
HA versus optional zonal quorum failure profiles and cross-zone replication bytes are explicit; budget pressure cannot weaken quorum or archive hard limits.

tasks.title: Implement durable consensus adapter
tasks.goal: Meet the selected Rust library's exact storage/network contract.
deliverables: CommitLog provider, vote/log persistence, checksummed frames, volume identity and mTLS roles
validation: Library conformance plus fsync/rename/parent-directory failures, corrupted/torn records and lost volume identity.
definition_of_done: No memory or page-cache receipt is called durable; persistent evidence covers restart and leader kill.

tasks.title: Implement shared physical groups and admission
tasks.goal: Avoid per-shard consensus resource explosion.
deliverables: Logical-stream multiplexing, tenant quotas, bounded group/queue/disk reserves and group metrics
validation: 1k/10k logical stream resource sweep; one hot tenant and stalled group under load.
Meter required remote follower payloads, read subscriptions, retransmission/catch-up and archive requests under each supported failure profile.
definition_of_done: Resource curves are bounded by active capacity; no unbounded thread/timer per idle shard.

tasks.title: Implement bootstrap, reconfiguration and snapshots
tasks.goal: Change voter topology without independent competing groups.
deliverables: Activation binding, learner catch-up, library-safe membership, group snapshot and shutdown lifecycle
validation: Initial empty voter, leader loss during reconfigure, snapshot installation/corruption and stalled close.
definition_of_done: Exactly one activated authority; volume locks persist until workers stop; all multiplexed stream metadata survives snapshot.

tasks.title: Integrate committed-only application and fresh replicas
tasks.goal: Make quorum receipt and serving visibility distinct.
deliverables: Quorum mutation path, committed replay subscriptions, replica eligibility and refresh tokens
validation: Refresh during failed append, dependent preparation, leader changes and subscription gap/cancellation.
definition_of_done: Only committed prefix reaches readers; original operation identities and outcomes survive replay.

tasks.title: Implement archive and safe journal truncation
tasks.goal: Make object recovery coverage authoritative for reclaim.
deliverables: Encrypted WAL chunks, contiguous archive catalog, group/shard checkpoint mapping and pin-aware truncation
validation: Drop upload/CAS response, partial archive, stalled follower, old PIT and disk watermark faults.
definition_of_done: Truncation never removes needed unarchived/pinned history; archive lag blocks admission at hard budget.

tasks.title: Implement validated profiles and safe budget controls
tasks.goal: Make latency/reliability choices explicit and constrain cost-driven adaptation.
deliverables: Persisted profile/policy descriptor, topology/capability validator and policy generation in receipts/diagnostics
Bounded optional-work budgets, forecast alerts, maintenance debt limits and authorized migration/impact workflow
validation: Reject HA profile with same-zone voters, unsupported/zonal-only authority claiming regional durability and incompatible key/residency settings
Inject cost pressure, archive outage, stalled compaction/CCR and revoked key; attempt quorum/freshness/pin/key-lifetime downgrades
definition_of_done: Controller may defer permitted work or reject new admission, never alter acknowledged durability/security/freshness or discard live retention
Reliability/authority changes require explicit selected policy, fencing/migration and valid authorization; maintenance debt cannot grow without a bound

tasks.title: Implement durability-mode migration
tasks.goal: Switch between object and quorum authority with explicit barriers.
deliverables: Quiesce/seal/recovery/publish/activate protocol, mode-aware API and rollback boundaries
validation: Crash at every transition; mixed old nodes; tokens from old activation and missing target prefix.
definition_of_done: No dual-writer window; rollback after new writes requires reverse migration, not toggling config.

tasks.title: Qualify quorum failure envelope
tasks.goal: Prove actual safety and measure lower-latency benefit.
deliverables: Independent receipt campaign, partition/corruption/reconfiguration/zone-loss report and paired benchmark
validation: Native real processes/volumes with fsync faults, majority loss, total voter loss and archive recovery.
definition_of_done: One-zone RPO=0 within declared envelope; total-disk-loss RPO matches archive checkpoint; SLOs measured without semantic downgrade.

milestones.title: Snapshot, export and change-stream contracts
milestones.goal: Create shared primitives for backup, independent copy and continuous replication.
definition_of_done: A snapshot cut pins all segment, schema, key and committed-tail dependencies before it is exported.
Change stream provides ordered resolved operations and explicit gaps/retention over both durability modes.
Destination import staging is durable and hidden until verified activation; contracts are public and module independent.

tasks.title: Implement snapshot barrier and durable pins
tasks.goal: Capture a complete recoverable cut, including unarchived tail.
deliverables: Snapshot descriptor, vector checkpoint, coordinated pin creation/renewal and base+tail inventory
validation: Concurrent writes/GC, quorum archive lag, pin expiry/renewal response loss and multi-shard capture.
definition_of_done: No acknowledged operation before the declared cut is omitted; snapshot consistency scope is explicit.

tasks.title: Implement export and logical reindex paths
tasks.goal: Support physical-compatible and format/topology-changing transfers.
deliverables: Versioned file/schema export API, scoped grants, logical document iterator and format negotiation
validation: Unsupported engine/cipher, source recreation, bounded batches and traversal/SSRF controls.
definition_of_done: Export binds source UUID/incarnation/cut and never exposes long-lived provider secrets.

tasks.title: Implement committed change stream and retention leases
tasks.goal: Supply durable ordered CDC without unbounded history.
deliverables: Resolved-op stream, schema/topology events, replay ranges, lease budgets and gap responses
validation: Duplicates, gaps, lease expiry, slow consumer and source split/format upgrade histories.
definition_of_done: Consumers cannot acknowledge beyond durable source prefix; expired history requires explicit rebootstrap.

tasks.title: Implement destination import transactions
tasks.goal: Checkpoint verified data before making it public.
deliverables: Private staging index, verified chunk ledger, source/local sequence map and activation CAS
validation: Crash after transfer/before progress/after activation, name collisions and tampered chunk hashes.
definition_of_done: Resume is idempotent; incomplete destination never appears searchable through active aliases.

tasks.title: Qualify external consumers and disabled modules
tasks.goal: Prove reusable contracts without controller coupling.
deliverables: Example snapshot/change-stream client and import conformance suite
validation: Build without copy/CCR and exercise export/snapshot; scope denial and unsupported version controls.
definition_of_done: Core contracts work independently and match both object and quorum sources.

milestones.title: Independent cross-cluster copy module
milestones.goal: Deliver resumable one-time copies with independent destination storage and encryption.
definition_of_done: Two separate RustFS deployments complete a snapshot-cut copy with destination policy and bounded resources.
Pause/resume/cancel and process loss cannot mix source cuts, duplicate activation or delete unrelated data.
Completed destination recovers/searches after source network, storage and KMS access are blocked.

tasks.title: Build copy controller lifecycle
tasks.goal: Separate copy jobs from source/destination core services.
deliverables: Optional copy crate/capabilities/endpoints, persistent state machine and source/destination grants
validation: Disabled-module calls, duplicate request identity, crash at state transitions and name collisions.
definition_of_done: Only valid scoped jobs start; same request resolves to one durable job/outcome.

tasks.title: Implement bounded transfer and re-encryption
tasks.goal: Materialize independent destination bytes under destination keys.
deliverables: Streaming chunk workers, bandwidth/memory quotas, fresh DEKs/domains and durable progress
validation: Throttle/partition/retry/corrupt range, revoked source/destination keys and cross-tenant context controls.
definition_of_done: Verified chunks checkpoint only after destination durability; cross-domain copies re-encrypt.

tasks.title: Implement pause, cancel and cleanup
tasks.goal: Make partial work recoverable and safely reclaimable.
deliverables: Pin renewal, resumable progress, staged cleanup queue and cancellation statuses
validation: Expire pin during transfer, restart workers, cancel during activation, race GC and unrelated index creation.
definition_of_done: No mixed snapshot cut or deletion outside job scope; completed activation survives cancellation race.

tasks.title: Verify and atomically activate destination
tasks.goal: Prove actual data/key independence before completion.
deliverables: Hash/count/logical digest/query verification, destination-only restore and alias activation
validation: Block source network/credentials/KMS, delete source after pin release, reopen destination on fresh workers.
definition_of_done: Destination recovers full declared cut with its own keys and no source dependency; status includes proof artifacts.

tasks.title: Qualify copy module end to end
tasks.goal: Close copy behavior and observability acceptance.
deliverables: Two-cluster fault campaign, cost/throughput report and operator/AI runbook
validation: Concurrent source updates, topology/engine mismatch logical reindex, certificate rotation and independent recovery.
Attribute source/destination operation, re-encryption/KMS, inter-region/provider egress, retries and failed/cancelled transfer cost.
definition_of_done: Module can drain/disable after jobs finish; coverage/review pass; no prefix-only test substitutes for separate clusters.

milestones.title: Cross-cluster replication module
milestones.goal: Deliver asynchronous follower-pull replication with bounded history, explicit lag and safe promotion.
definition_of_done: Follower bootstrap and continuous resolved-operation replication preserve source identity/schema under restart and at-least-once delivery.
History/lease budgets, read-only enforcement, pause/resume/expiry/rebootstrap and topology changes have negative evidence.
Planned promotion fences source and waits for declared cut; unplanned promotion never silently claims zero RPO or proves remote death by timeout.

tasks.title: Create follower binding and scoped trust
tasks.goal: Bind one follower to one immutable source identity.
deliverables: Optional CCR crate, replication epochs, source export/destination import grants and read-only enforcement
validation: Cross-tenant/role/mTLS denial, source name recreation and bulk/alias write bypass controls.
definition_of_done: Follower public writes are rejected; source and destination membership are not merged.

tasks.title: Bootstrap snapshot with tail retention
tasks.goal: Avoid losing operations while initial snapshot transfers.
deliverables: Coordinated snapshot+stream lease, shared transfer/import reuse and atomic bootstrap checkpoint
validation: GC between pin/lease registration, writes during copy, bootstrap restart and key rotation.
definition_of_done: Follower starts streaming exactly after the captured source cut without gaps.

tasks.title: Implement durable stream apply and checkpoints
tasks.goal: Advance follower only after destination durability.
deliverables: Bounded pull batches, idempotent source/local map, schema-before-op and durable/applied/searchable status
validation: Duplicate/out-of-order/gap/tampered operations; crash after durable import before reply; forced schema changes.
definition_of_done: Different payload under one source identity stops replication; reported progress is contiguous and durable.

tasks.title: Implement retention, pause/resume and rebootstrap
tasks.goal: Bound lag cost and make expired history explicit.
deliverables: Lease byte/time caps, pause/stop/detach, expiry states and new-snapshot workflow
validation: Long partition, slow follower, source disk pressure, expired lease and concurrent detach.
definition_of_done: Default follower cannot retain unbounded source WAL or silently block all source tenants.

tasks.title: Replicate topology and compatibility transitions
tasks.goal: Follow source resharding and format evolution safely.
deliverables: Split/merge barriers, event negotiation and source-schema/format compatibility matrix
validation: Split during backlog, unsupported writer format, mixed-version follower and expired old topology pins.
definition_of_done: Checkpoint/pin handoff covers old and new streams before source history release.

tasks.title: Implement promotion and failback workflow
tasks.goal: Prevent accidental split brain and hidden RPO loss.
deliverables: Planned fence/catch-up/activate protocol, explicit unplanned DR path and reverse migration runbook
validation: Partition source while follower healthy; delayed old writer; destination writes before attempted rollback.
definition_of_done: Planned promotion proves final cut; unplanned flow declares possible suffix loss and requires valid fencing/authorization.

tasks.title: Qualify CCR module and AI operations
tasks.goal: Prove end-to-end remote durability and diagnosis.
deliverables: Two-cluster long-run histories, lag/cost report and typed status diagnostics
validation: Source/destination kills, cert/key rotations, storage outage, promotion/failback and module drain.
Count steady-state and catch-up/lease/rebootstrap cost separately, including source retention and destination crypto operations.
definition_of_done: Independent receipts/data queries pass across declared cases; async RPO and retention limits are visible.

milestones.title: Catalog foundation, elasticity and fleet scaling
milestones.goal: Remove per-index resource floors and deliver safe hot-partition growth.
definition_of_done: Idle million-tenant catalog model has no per-idle-index worker/timer/group requirement and measured bounded enumeration/activation.
Hot shards split/rebalance under writes with fenced routing transitions and preserved PIT/replication retention.
Physical journal/query resources scale with active capacity, with skew/fairness/admission evidence.
Idle/sparse/active/skewed tenancy, per-zone duplicate warmth and recovery traffic meet the selected profile cost envelope, not just a throughput target.

tasks.title: Implement paged catalog and cold activation budgets
tasks.goal: Make idle tenancy cheap and activation bounded.
deliverables: Catalog partition strategy, lazy engine lifecycle, active caps and footprint simulator
validation: 1M tenants/50M-index model with >=99% idle, burst activation and catalog repair.
definition_of_done: No O(total indexes) per-node polling/resource cost; model assumptions and real tested sizes are separate.
Paged catalog/cold-activation mechanisms land before standalone/distributed API integration; later M13 tasks still own full elasticity/fleet proof.

tasks.title: Implement tenant fairness and hot placement
tasks.goal: Isolate cache/CPU/I/O and avoid hotspot collapse.
deliverables: Per-tenant admission, weighted placement, cache quotas, load feedback and bounded subscriptions
validation: One hot tenant with many small tenants; cold cache storm, skew and AZ imbalance.
definition_of_done: Tenant SLO interference and rejected work are measured; moving compute doesn't change authority.

tasks.title: Deliver online logical shard split and cutover
tasks.goal: Scale hot write partitions without ambiguous routing.
deliverables: Snapshot/catch-up/split barriers, routing generation, fenced cutover and old topology pins
validation: Write/delete/CAS during split, crash at cutover, stale routing, PIT and change-stream consumers.
definition_of_done: Each document has one authoritative partition per routing generation; no loss/duplication and old views stay valid.

tasks.title: Qualify bounded physical group scaling
tasks.goal: Separate logical partition count from quorum resource count.
deliverables: Group allocation/migration policy, active stream caps and resource slope report
validation: 1k/10k streams plus simulated 100k; move hot streams and fail/reconfigure groups.
definition_of_done: No one-group-per-idle-shard default; actual memory/thread/fd/disk costs are recorded.

tasks.title: Run scale and cost ladder
tasks.goal: Prove measured expansion and document remaining fleet limits.
deliverables: L1/L2 campaign, L3 model, object/egress/KMS cost model and bottleneck report
validation: Fixed data/hardware/arrival profiles; cache below working set, GC/compaction/CCR concurrent load.
Include idle metadata/polling floor, duplicate zone cache, failed-zone cold rebuild and all explicit profile constraints.
definition_of_done: Tested topology sizes and unknown L4 claims are explicit; misses produce tracked work before release promise.

milestones.title: Performance kernels and native hardware
milestones.goal: Optimize measured bottlenecks while preserving reference behavior on ARM and x86.
definition_of_done: Release x86_64/aarch64 paths run natively and all accelerated kernels match scalar/reference boundary cases.
Unsafe additions have safety proofs, applicable tooling and measured whole-system benefit; fallback remains supported.
Cold/warm/open-loop measurements meet frozen targets or remain explicit release blockers.
Performance changes improve a measured cost/latency Pareto point or justified constraint; request/byte/compaction/KMS amplification is included.

tasks.title: Establish profiles and noise-aware regression gates
tasks.goal: Choose optimizations from actual end-to-end costs.
deliverables: CPU/IO/alloc/network/lock profiles, paired baselines and benchmark threshold policy
validation: Repeat/interleave runs with configuration hashes; quantify CI/dedicated-worker variance.
definition_of_done: No hardware optimization is justified solely by microbench marketing or uncontrolled CI timing.

tasks.title: Optimize remote I/O, cache and batching
tasks.goal: Reduce dependent reads/requests and refresh/merge overhead.
deliverables: Measured block/prefetch/pack/cache/commit policies with bounded speculative work
validation: Cold/warm/mixed load, read/write amplification, compaction interference and archive-stall tests.
Measure useful bytes versus prefetched/packed/rewritten/retained bytes plus cache/metadata/KMS request amplification.
definition_of_done: Latency/cost improve without changing durability/freshness; working set exceeds cache during cold qualification.

tasks.title: Implement target-dispatched SIMD kernels
tasks.goal: Accelerate hottest decode/search/vector paths where engine hooks permit.
deliverables: Scalar and SSE/AVX2/NEON paths; optional AVX-512/SVE capability adapters
validation: Property/differential tests for tails/alignment/NaN/overflow, force-disabled features and native x86/ARM runs.
definition_of_done: Unsupported CPUs never execute new instructions; no precision/relevance change is hidden.

tasks.title: Audit unsafe and optional system acceleration
tasks.goal: Use low-level changes only with proofs and fallback.
deliverables: Narrow unsafe kernels, safety docs, Miri/ASan corpus; optional io_uring/NUMA/allocator experiments
validation: Bad-length/lifetime/alias controls; resource saturation; normal-IO fallback on unsupported kernel.
definition_of_done: Each accepted unsafe/system change has an observed bottleneck and end-to-end win; rejected experiments stay documented.

tasks.title: Qualify hardware encryption performance
tasks.goal: Verify cipher backend dispatch and quantify security cost.
deliverables: AES-NI/PMULL and software-path results, optional VAES trial, key-cache/throughput profiles
validation: Paired encrypted/plaintext query/ingest/copy, KMS cold/cache-hit and no-acceleration runs.
definition_of_done: Selected backend and all safety checks are observable; encryption is not bypassed to meet a benchmark.

tasks.title: Close performance acceptance
tasks.goal: Meet or explicitly fail frozen service budgets.
deliverables: Release-profile L1 benchmark/cost report and regression artifacts
validation: Open-loop supported query/write mix with overload/recovery, native ARM/x86 and background maintenance.
definition_of_done: All required targets and correctness gates pass; unresolved target misses block matching release claims.

milestones.title: Cloud storage and KMS provider qualification
milestones.goal: Extend real RustFS behavior to S3, GCS and Azure with their own measured semantics and keys.
definition_of_done: Actual S3, GCS and Azure backends pass the required conformance/race/recovery suites; no emulator-only result certifies them.
Actual AWS/GCP/Azure key providers pass wrap/unwrap/version/permission/rotation/revocation tests with workload identity.
Cross-provider copy/CCR restores independently and records residency/egress/key policy and provider-specific limits.
Provider cost profiles use actual regional/path/SKU/byte-unit rates and usage/billing reconciliation; provider-specific transfer exemptions are validated.

tasks.title: Deliver S3 and AWS KMS adapters
tasks.goal: Qualify exact AWS object/identity/key semantics.
deliverables: Production S3/KMS providers, least-privilege policy and endpoint/version handling
validation: Actual conditional-write/unknown-response/multipart/range histories; KMS grant/version/revoke/rotate tests.
definition_of_done: Real account/region artifacts pass; unsupported capability blocks readiness and missing credentials report NOT-RUN.

tasks.title: Deliver GCS and Cloud KMS adapters
tasks.goal: Use generations and provider key context correctly.
deliverables: GCS/KMS providers with workload identity and generation-pinned reads
validation: Actual generation preconditions, overwrite/range races, key versions/permissions/outage and recovery.
definition_of_done: No S3 ETag assumption leaks into GCS; real-provider evidence and scope limits are recorded.

tasks.title: Deliver Azure Blob and Key Vault adapters
tasks.goal: Qualify Azure object and wrapping contracts.
deliverables: Azure providers, ETag conditions, key-version handling and workload credentials
validation: Actual conditional operations, paging/range, key wrap/unwrap/deny/rotate and retry/cancel histories.
definition_of_done: Provider errors preserve unknown/conflict/denial distinctions and real restored data is verified.

tasks.title: Qualify cross-provider transfer and DR
tasks.goal: Prove portable data and destination key independence.
deliverables: S3/GCS/Azure/RustFS copy+CCR matrix, residency/network policy and cost evidence
validation: At least one transfer to/from each provider; source access removed; rekey/format mismatch/long-RTT faults.
Compare actual routed/billed traffic with declared provider exemptions; record current regional rates and GB/GiB units.
definition_of_done: Destination needs only its own storage/keys; untested pairs are explicit and cannot be called supported.

tasks.title: Qualify cost, latency and reliability Pareto curves
tasks.goal: Compare complete supported profiles at matched workload scope rather than advertise one cheapest bill.
deliverables: Sparse/busy/skewed idle/cold/warm/overload/recovery profile matrix, raw operation/byte counts and total-cost inventory
Batch/pack/cohort/cache/refresh/zone/compaction/replication sweeps with dominated choices identified
validation: Run matched logical correctness/security histories and each selected failure envelope, including zone loss, rebuild, catch-up, copy/CCR and key rotation
Use rate snapshots plus actual compute/disk/cache inventory; include KMS, retries, page writes, network services and recovery debt
Measure implemented multi-worker scale/cost curves against M02.05 thresholds; provider results support but do not replace M17.03 full-service G06 qualification
definition_of_done: Every advertised profile meets its own frozen constraints or stays blocked; weakened semantics are explicit in comparisons
Savings cannot come from omitted metadata, unknown rates, free cache assumptions, test skips or reduced replica guarantees under the same label

tasks.title: Reconcile real-provider usage and bills
tasks.goal: Validate that the modeled savings survive actual cloud paths, SKU rules and provider charging.
deliverables: S3/GCS/Azure rate/path profiles and scoped usage/billing export reconciliation with explained residuals
Infrastructure endpoint/route and LB/NAT/PrivateLink/TGW checks, explicit GB/GiB and sender/receiver payer mappings
validation: Compare meter projections to real provider usage and available billing exports for normal, retry, idle, failover and cross-cluster workloads
Verify same-region object exemptions separately from peer transfer; exercise Azure zero inter-zone tariff and provider-specific network exceptions
definition_of_done: Each cost-qualified provider/profile has a documented workload/rate-date/unit/path and reconciliation tolerance fixed before the run
Missing credentials/billing access or unexplained mismatch is NOT-RUN/blocked, not a zero-cost/pass result

tasks.title: Publish provider support contracts
tasks.goal: Make tested support reproducible and operational.
deliverables: Provider version/topology matrix, capability reports, IAM/KMS/restore runbooks and spend limits
validation: Fresh environment setup/restore by a separate runner using scoped temporary credentials.
definition_of_done: Each supported provider has real safety/DR evidence; access/budget gaps stay blocked tasks rather than fake passes.

milestones.title: Migration, compatibility and harness hardening
milestones.goal: Make the product and development workflow usable end to end with upgrade/rollback boundaries.
definition_of_done: Declared core/module profiles and explicitly adapted workloads pass shadow/replay/copy workflows with pinned discrepancy reports; out-of-profile OpenSearch semantics are documented application gaps, not universal replacement obligations.
Rolling engine/protocol/format changes respect old readers and downgrade limits; a published engine release can replace its Git pin safely.
AI harness achieves bounded context/review/worktree behavior on realistic tasks; Linux remains primary and optional native ports are honestly qualified.
Profile selection, budget diagnostics and authorized cost/reliability transitions are usable without silently changing prior receipt guarantees.

tasks.title: Qualify supported-profile migration and client adapters
tasks.goal: Prove migration for declared supported/adapted workloads without a universal OpenSearch replacement promise.
deliverables: Bulk/query/error compatibility fixtures, shadow read/dual-write reconciliation and import tooling
validation: Supported client versions and M02 corpus; routing/version/deletes/aliases/aggregations under shadow traffic.
definition_of_done: Selected matching behavior passes pinned client/config fixtures; every intentional difference has an adaptation report and every out-of-profile workload blocks only its own migration claim.

tasks.title: Implement upgrade, format and engine adoption policy
tasks.goal: Upgrade without stranding old data or tokens.
deliverables: Read/write format epochs, rolling-version matrix, engine release pin update procedure and old-data fixtures
validation: Old/new node coexistence, unsupported format refusal, engine revision change, key/module compatibility and rollback.
definition_of_done: Downgrade boundary is explicit after new format publication; all advertised old indexes recover.

tasks.title: Exercise cutover, rollback and failback
tasks.goal: Control irreversible routing/data changes.
deliverables: Dry-run migration plan, final fence/barrier, alias cutover and reverse migration runbooks
validation: Partial cutover, destination new writes, source partition and lost coordinator with independent receipts.
definition_of_done: Rollback never discards acknowledged destination writes; post-cutover return requires valid reverse transfer.

tasks.title: Harden AI review and context efficiency
tasks.goal: Validate the full AI development loop on production code.
deliverables: Refreshed task corpus, token/timing/escaped-defect comparison, progress/router maintenance and stale-evidence controls
validation: Parallel real module tasks with LSP unavailable, reviewer crash, conflicting API and quota exhaustion.
definition_of_done: No seeded critical escape, bounded review termination, measured token budgets and restartable task history.

tasks.title: Qualify portability and developer onboarding
tasks.goal: Support practical Windows/macOS development without compromising Linux.
deliverables: Fresh WSL2/Linux-container guide, Linux x86/ARM CI, optional native macOS/Windows smoke matrix
validation: Fresh-machine bootstrap, paths/locks/sockets/TLS and filesystem behavior; distinguish smoke from runtime support.
definition_of_done: WSL/container path works; native support claims match tests and do not block Linux solely for optional conveniences.

tasks.title: Publish cost operations and AI decision evidence
tasks.goal: Make profiles, budget drift and safe tradeoffs reviewable by operators and AI.
deliverables: Profile selection/migration runbooks, bounded cost/traffic explain API and price refresh procedure
AI incident corpus for NAT hairpin, polling/CAS floor, key-operation storm, stale cheap reader and budget-induced maintenance debt
validation: Diagnose injected cost drivers from scoped operator tools and generate matched impact plans without automatic reliability downgrade
Exercise planned profile change and reject an unsafe change while retaining original receipt semantics
definition_of_done: Operators can see changed latency/RPO/RTO/capacity and modeled/reconciled spend before an authorized transition
AI cost evidence distinguishes observations, simulations and invoices; active product guarantees remain enforced

tasks.title: Validate external extension example and final docs
tasks.goal: Make modules usable and docs trustworthy for another agent.
deliverables: Out-of-tree provider/query example, API/schema docs, incident/release/migration guides and updated ledger
validation: New agent implements bounded extension from public docs only; link/command/example and capability tests.
definition_of_done: No private core import is required; documentation accurately identifies actual versus proposed commands.

milestones.title: Failure, scale and release qualification
milestones.goal: Prove the declared product contract and execute a controlled Linux-first release with operational recovery evidence.
definition_of_done: Every required feature/provider/module/architecture matrix has current passing evidence tied to the release tree; no NOT-RUN result closes a release requirement.
>=90% first-party production line coverage floors, independent architecture/code/test reviews, security gates, native x86/ARM and 72-hour soak pass.
Failure/restore/CCR/copy/key/cert/upgrade/migration drills meet frozen scope and SLOs; supported limits and residual risks are published.
Reproducible signed artifacts, SBOM/provenance and canary promotion/rollback are verified within authorized release scope.
R23 cost cost envelopes and supported operating profiles pass current matched semantics/usage/failure evidence before release.

tasks.title: Run full requirement-by-requirement release audit
tasks.goal: Match every original requirement to authoritative current evidence.
deliverables: Release matrix linking R01-R23 to test/run/commit artifacts and unresolved blockers
validation: Inspect actual commands, runtime behaviors, coverage denominator, module/provider/hardware claims and reviews.
Audit the actual runtime capability manifest against core-v1 and module profiles; no unimplemented API, unsupported client or invented exactness claim may ship
definition_of_done: No requirement is treated as passed by intent, a file name, skipped job, indirect test or a narrower substitute.

tasks.title: Run durability, security and disaster drills
tasks.goal: Prove the stated failure envelope end to end.
deliverables: Receipt-ledger histories for node/zone/disk/storage/key/cert failures and fresh-host restores
validation: Inject partitions/SIGKILL/fsync faults/corruption, total compute loss, key revocation/rotation and GC races.
definition_of_done: No acknowledged loss inside contract; outside-envelope exposure matches declared archive/CCR RPO.

tasks.title: Run long soak and scale/performance gates
tasks.goal: Check sustained correctness and resource debt.
deliverables: 72-hour mixed workload, L1/L2 scale results, leak/cost/latency and capacity report
validation: Concurrent compaction/copy/CCR, working set >cache, hot tenants, split/rebalance, overload/recovery on x86/ARM.

Qualify G06 on the actual service at increasing worker counts against the M02.05 frozen numerical scale-efficiency, latency and cost bounds; retain matched workload and offered/completed/rejected load
definition_of_done: Frozen SLOs pass with no growing replay/archive/GC/RSS debt; raw histograms/config/hardware evidence retained.
No supported cost envelope is passed using only warm steady-state or by omitting idle/control/recovery/KMS/network service components.

tasks.title: Complete independent review and operational acceptance
tasks.goal: Close final architecture/security/test concerns with evidence.
deliverables: Final-tree review verdicts, >=90% coverage reports, AI incident drill and runbook exercise
validation: Review exact candidate; seed stale verdict/false-green control; operate restore/promotion from documented tools.
definition_of_done: Blocking findings resolved; operator-visible tools diagnose failures without secrets; candidate hash matches all required runs.

tasks.title: Build reproducible release artifacts and canary plan
tasks.goal: Prepare a concrete reviewable Linux release.
deliverables: Pinned builds, native x86/ARM binaries/images, SBOM/licenses/provenance/signature and canary/rollback package
validation: Rebuild/verify artifacts, no-secrets scan, staging install/upgrade/rollback and feature capability inspection.
definition_of_done: Artifact identity and deployment plan are concrete; external publish/promote follows existing user authorization.

tasks.title: Execute controlled release and close progress
tasks.goal: Deliver the release only after all required work is proven.
deliverables: Authorized staged canary/promotion, post-release validation and final milestone evidence
validation: Monitor meaningful health/latency/lag/security signals, exercise rollback trigger, audit requirement ledger after promotion.
definition_of_done: Release contract is achieved on the supported scope; any missing real infrastructure/evidence keeps task and goal incomplete.
